title: Backend API (PostgreSQL Only)
description: Lightweight local backend service for PostgreSQL communication. Exposes three endpoints: test connection, read schema, and apply schema. Browser cannot open direct database connections.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests PostgreSQL connection and returns success or descriptive error
Backend introspects PostgreSQL schema and returns structured data
Backend applies DDL to PostgreSQL after user confirmation
Backend never drops existing database objects
Backend runs locally with minimal API surface
